name: odin-iii
source: Keyswitches copied from Jordan's own Cubase Expression Map 'ODIN 3 HJ 2' (C:\Users\only1\Documents\Cubase Maps and being extra\Cubase Expression Maps\ODIN 3 HJ 2 3.expressionmap; 'ODIN 3 HJ' and 'ODIN 3' in the same folder are identical). Checked 2026-11-05 against TEST-FILE.cpr: guitar 1 / guitar 2 / Gtr Clean / Gtr_Clean_2 use that map and the Cubase Key Editor shows the same slots (C0 Alt Pick, C#0 Dwn Pick ...). Note numbers are MIDI numbers; Cubase names them with C3 = 60, so 24 = 'C0' and 12 = 'C-1' in Cubase. The keyswitches sit at MIDI 0-35 (+101), so playable notes are kept at 36 and up ('range').
how_jordan_uses_it: See claude_code/skills/jordan-guitars/SKILL.md. Short version: chug riffs = Down Open Palm Mute (with Up Open Palm Mute on the off-beat pickups) at a flat velocity ~98; held/accented chords = Down Pick at velocity 117; lead and melody lines = Down Mute Semi / Alt Pick at 84 with 117 accents; one Nasty Pinch Harmonic at a riff's peak; whammy-style pitch-bend wobble (+2/-2 semitones) on the last beat of a phrase.
notes: Solemn Tones Odin III: standalone VST3 8-string baritone, every fret on every string. Odin's own Keyswitch Latching is OFF on all of Jordan's instances, so the renderer holds the keyswitch for each note it affects (keyswitch_latching=false). Articulations with a keyswitch use it; anything else falls back to the velocity bands (fitted to the velocities Jordan uses). Per-track tone settings (vibrato, pickup, pick attack, tuning scale) live in the Odin instances of the Cubase template, not here.
velocity_bands_source: Odin III factory velocity map (official walkthrough klAbrHifvnY 0:59): 127 pinch, 126-35 normal, 34-25 palm mute, 24-15 closed mute, 14-0 dead. 'open' uses Jordan's 84-125 inside the normal band. Only used when an articulation has no keyswitch.
